Dy]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Lakas–CMD}}|border=darkgray}} [[Lakas–CMD]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Isabela's 3rd congressional district''' is one of the six [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Isabela (province)|Isabela]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 13, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consists of the west-central municipalities of [[Alicia, Isabela|Alicia]], [[Angadanan]], [[Cabatuan, Isabela|Cabatuan]], [[Ramon, Isabela|Ramon]] and [[San Mateo, Isabela|San Mateo]].{{cite web|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2018/09/27/republic-act-no-11080/ |title=Republic Act No. 11080 |date=27 September 2018 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=February 13, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Ian Paul Dy|Ian Paul L. Dy]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 13, 2021}} Prior to its redistricting effective 2019, which increased the province's districts to six, it consisted of the municipalities of Alicia, Angadanan, Cabatuan, [[Cauayan, Isabela|Cauayan]], [[Luna, Isabela|Luna]], [[Reina Mercedes, Isabela|Reina Mercedes]], [[San Guillermo, Isabela|San Guillermo]], and San Mateo. ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
